    Profile

    Teona is the most popular female swordfighter in Gluttony Foss. She hates it though that she’s often compared to her deceased older brother, or that people look down on her because she’s a girl. On a daily basis, she exhibits this competitive spirit of hers at the arena. Once she puts down her blade, she spends a lot of time in front of the mirror, so there’s also a girly side to her.

    Origin: Gluttony Foss
    Gender: Female
    Height: 165cm
    Weight: 49kg
    Birthday: May 21
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Cheese and yogurt
    Hobbies: Viewing historic sites
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 若林直美
